environment.skill_delivery: --append-system-prompt with the arm's SKILL.md text; plus, same rule for every arm, the arm's skill folder copied into the checkout before the session and git-excluded via .git/info/exclude (never in the diff or graded): ponytail -> .claude/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md; tightloop-v3 -> its folder benchmark/arms/tightloop-v3/ at .claude/skills/tightloop/; tightloop-v4 -> .claude/skills/tightloop/ (SKILL.md, gate.sh, phases/) at the same path; tightloop-v4a -> its folder benchmark/arms/tightloop-v4a/ at .claude/skills/tightloop/; tightloop-v4b -> benchmark/arms/tightloop-v4b/ at the same path; tightloop-v5 -> benchmark/arms/tightloop-v5/ (SKILL.md, look.py, gate.sh, phases/) at the same path; tightloop-v5b -> benchmark/arms/tightloop-v5b/ at the same path; no-skill -> nothing (no system-prompt text, no files)
environment.prompt: task instruction with upstream PR refs like (#123) removed
environment.network: Claude Code built-in web tools denied with --disallowedTools WebFetch WebSearch. NOT network-isolated: the CLI needs the model API, and its Bash tool (cargo, go, git, curl) keeps network access.
unmeasured_fields: model (claude -p JSON has no top-level model; see model_from_modelUsage per row)
environment.notes: tokens.cache = cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens; tokens.cache_read and tokens.cache_creation are the two parts. claude runs with --output-format stream-json --verbose; tool_calls = distinct tool_use ids in the event stream (exact count, subagents included), tool_calls_main = those not inside a subagent
environment.grading_rename_rule: after the session and before the hidden patch: a test function the agent ADDED (Rust `fn NAME(`, Go `func NAME(`) whose name equals a hidden test name is renamed NAME_agent; same rule on every arm; the raw diff is saved to diffs/ before the rename
environment.overlap_rule: row overlap=overlapped if at any sample (start, about every 30 s, end) the lock was held by another process or a process outside the session had its cwd under /tmp/eyes; else clean. lock wait scope: session. Compare wall time only within the same overlap tag.
